findings.evidence: Three call sites already have to invoke it by hand: FieldPoints.lean:116 `simpa only [TauCeti.toGL_transvection_eq_transvectionUnit]`, Sl2/Kostant/Points.lean:135 and :152 `rw [toGL_transvection_eq_transvectionUnit hij]`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]`; the LHS `toGL (SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij c)` cannot loop since `transvectionUnit`'s body is unexposed.
findings.issue: `toGL_transvection_eq_transvectionUnit` is the fold-direction bridge from Mathlib's `SpecialLinearGroup.transvection` into the canonical `transvectionUnit` API, but carries no `@[simp]`, while every other characteristic lemma in the same section (`coe_transvectionUnit`, `transvectionUnit_zero/_add/_inv`, `det_transvectionUnit`, `map_transvectionUnit`) is `@[simp]`.

findings.evidence: `grep -n diag2n` in this file yields only line 610, inside the proof of `closure_range_toSpecialLinearGroup_eq_top_of_field`. Downstream `Connected.lean` gets the Diagonal API via its own `import ...SpecialLinear.DiagonalPath` (Connected.lean:12, DiagonalPath.lean:9), so nothing depends on the re-export.
findings.fix: Make it a plain `import` with the file's usual explanatory comment (cf. the annotated non-public imports in GeneralLinearGroup/Transvection.lean:14-16).
findings.issue: `public import TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.Diagonal` re-exports the whole `diag2nUnit`/`diag2n` API to every consumer of this module, although `diag2n_decompose` is used only inside a proof; no public statement in the file mentions `diag2n`.

findings.evidence: FieldPoints.lean:141-159 gives three field lemmas; lines 163-176 give only two integer lemmas; the docstring at lines 27-36 lists five names, not including `mem_points_int_iff_det_eq_one`.
findings.fix: Add the integer `toGL_mem_points` counterpart (one line from `points_int_eq_range_toGL`) and list `mem_points_int_iff_det_eq_one` in `## Main results`.
findings.issue: The file develops the field and integer cases in parallel but the integer side is incomplete: it has `points_int_eq_range_toGL` and `mem_points_int_iff_det_eq_one` with no counterpart to `toGL_mem_points` (line 149). The module docstring's `## Main results` list also omits `mem_points_int_iff_det_eq_one`.

summary: The generation surface is well chosen and the private/public split in FieldPoints.lean is right, but the new bridge lemma lacks the `@[simp]` its siblings all carry, a proof-only dependency is imported publicly, and the integer half of FieldPoints.lean stops one lemma short of the field half.
